abstract: For each $n \geq 2$, we construct an ascending chain of irreducible lattices in the product of $n$ homogeneous trees. Moreover, for each pair of integers $m_1, m_2 \geq 1$, we define explicitly a bi-reversible automaton $\mathcal B$ such that the group $G_{\mathcal B}$ defined by the automaton $\mathcal B$ has finiteness length $m_1$ (i.e. it is of type $\mathrm{F}_{m_1}$ but not of type $\mathrm{FP}_{m_1+1}$), and the group $G_{\mathcal B^*}$ defined by the dual automaton has finiteness length $m_2$. Both constructions rely on the consideration of $S$-arithmetic groups in the affine group of a global function field.
title: Ascending chains of irreducible lattices, bi-reversible automata and affine arithmetic groups
